About.1: Full-time video-based courses in every difficulty
About.4: Completely for free, if you're helping

1.Heading: Video-based courses
1.Body: We offer free and paid courses. Our courses contain almost everything that is taught when studying computer science. And we're working hard to erase the 'almost'.

2.Heading: Webinars
2.Body: Sometimes, there are questions, sometimes, we need someone to tell us about their work. That's why we have webinars. Held by you for you. Held by experts for those who want to become one.

3.Heading: Coaching
3.Body: You do want that individual help, you want an expert mentoring just you? Here you go!

4.Heading: Exercises
4.Body: We all love a challenges. That's why we already have a lot of coding challenges for you. But there's a lot more to come!

5.Heading: The Skill Tree
5.Body: Have you ever stood before the vast amount of coding languages and technologies and did not have the slightest idea what to learn next? That's why we designed a roadmap: The skilltree!

6.Heading: Certificates
6.Body: To apply for jobs or just for trophy hunting, there are real certificates. You don't get those for participating but for a real exam. We're working with colleges and companies to larger the benefit - and our network is growing.

1.Heading: How can I participate? How can I get MorphCoins?
1.Body: There are several possibilities to help us - and get coins: You can help me with a certain video, you can host a webinar, become a coach or you can help us with finding and repairing bugs. Additionally, you can buy MorphCoins directly via PayPal, SEPA direct debit, giropay, and debit/credit card. All payment methods are processed through PayPal. More details are

2.Heading: Is MorphCoin a cryptocurrency?
2.Body: No. It is a pure site-internal currency.

3.Heading: Your vlogs are not a skill here. Why?
3.Body: We're planning for integrating a whole new part for learning security awareness, but we did not want to keep everyone waiting. If you have some cool ideas, feel free to contact me.

4.Heading: I want to host a webinar. How?
4.Body: You first need to get that skill certified, so we can be sure, you actually know, what you're talking about. Then you need a certificate for some soft skills. After that, you can at any time you like.

5.Heading: I already studied computer science. Can I get my skills certified?
5.Body: Sure. Contact us! We need to do that manually so we know, it's true. That's why we need a few MorphCoins for it.

1.Heading: Buy MorphCoins
1.Body: You can buy MorphCoins using euros in the shop. This is possible directly via PayPal, SEPA direct debit, giropay, and debit/credit card. All payment methods are processed through PayPal.

2.Heading: Lectures
2.Body: Provide everything for a lecture. You still have that code of your last python project where you use cool libs? Or you just installed something on your server and created screenshots or even a video of every step you took? Send it over and I'll share it with the community. However, please be aware that this info will be public then! So you're transferring rights to me, meaning you first have to have those! So please, only original work. And if I have to fix too many bugs, I'll have to reduce your reward.

3.Heading: Webinars
3.Body: Host webinars as an instructor. You're an expert and want to share your knowledge in webinars? Contact me, if you've got the skills, I'm happy to have you. You yourself decide about the prices you take from the participants. You keep 80%! Only limitation: The webinar may not be for free - you know, we do want to keep developing this site.

4.Heading: Coach
4.Body: Apply and become a coach. Want to help people individually? You only need the skills you want to coach, some soft skills and you can start. Rates are totally up to you!

5.Heading: Bug Bounty
5.Body: Please report security vulnerabilities privately by email; the address is in our legal notice. Use the feedback button for ordinary bugs. Test only our platform using your own accounts. Don’t disrupt services, attack other users or third parties, or change anyone else’s data. If you accidentally see someone else’s data, don’t keep copies and report the finding privately. We may award Morphcoins for the first helpful report; the amount depends on the vulnerability and your report. A reward in euros requires an agreement with us before you start testing.
